commit.message: fix: pass PRIVATE_KEY env var to ext-proxy container

fix: correct simulated TEE's signature scheme to match tee-proxy/register()

Three independent protocol mismatches in the SIMULATED_TEE handler were
causing tee-proxy to panic on bootstrap and register() to revert:

- postResult signed the bare ActionResult hash instead of go-flare-common's
  domain-separated signing.Payload{TEE_ACTION_RESULT, chainId, dataHash}
  wrapper tee-proxy's recoverSigner actually verifies against, and the
  teeInfo response never carried a chainId field (so the proxy recomputed
  the wrapper with chainId=0) — together these caused "verifying response
  signature: signature check fail" on every TEE_INFO bootstrap attempt.

- machineData.dataSignature was signed over a JSON dump of the wrong
  struct instead of abi.encode(TeeMachineData) wrapped in the
  TEE_MACHINE_REGISTER domain-separated payload, per tee-node's
  types.MachineData.DataHash().

- machineData.extensionId was hardcoded to 0 instead of this project's
  actual registered extension ID (65749), and codeHash/platform were zero
  instead of the SIMULATED_TEE sentinel values register-tee's local
  pre-flight check expects — both caused register() to revert
  (OwnerNotAllowed / code hash mismatch) before ever reaching the chain.

Verified end-to-end: proxy now boots without panicking, and
register-tee's rap flow gets past pre-registration and attestation
on-chain.

feat: multi-bucket WEATHER markets with real payout enforcement

WEATHER markets now settle against custom temperature buckets instead of a
single rain threshold — createMarket takes an ascending bucketThresholds
array, requestWeatherSettlement resolves which bucket the measured
temperature (FDC-verified, signed) falls into, and settlement records
totalPool into the winning bucket's pool. placeBet's amount is now plaintext
(feeds totalPool on-chain) while only the bucket choice stays ECIES-encrypted.

Frontend: bucket template picker + editor on market creation, per-bucket
betting UI, totalPool display on cards/detail pages, city name reverse
lookup for WEATHER markets.

fix: read Your position from chain instead of localStorage

localStorage-per-browser turned out fragile in exactly the way that matters:
reported as "bet placed via frontend+MetaMask, still not showing" — most
likely because each `vercel --prod` mints a new unique deployment URL
(different origin -> different localStorage), and it also silently missed
anything not placed through that exact browser session in the first place.

Replaced with fetchUserBetForMarket in lib/blockscout.ts (same Blockscout
API already used for bet counts, since Coston2's public RPC rejects
address-filtered eth_getLogs): filters BetPlaced logs by bettor+marketId, so
it works from any browser/device/deployment URL as long as the same wallet
is connected. Verified against the actual on-chain data from this session's
testing (0xed2B57...78F5's bet on market 2 resolves correctly, an
unrelated market returns none).

PlaceBetDialog now invalidates the "user-bet" react-query cache after a
successful tx (immediately + a delayed retry, since Blockscout indexes with
a short lag) instead of writing to localStorage. bet-history.ts is now dead
code, removed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: show "Your position" after betting and bet count on market cards

Your position (market detail, below Place a Bet): after a successful
placeBet tx, records the tx hash in localStorage (per marketId+address) and
shows "Bet placed (encrypted) — View on Blockscout". Side/amount stay
TEE-private by design, so this only confirms existence + links to the tx;
it's device-local, not synced from chain.

Bet count (market list cards): requested as a totalPool display, but
PredictionMarket.sol has no such field — bet amounts are intentionally
private (TEE-only), and the contract only tracks a global pooled balance,
not per-market totals. Substituted a bet count instead (existence is public,
amount isn't), sourced by counting BetPlaced events per marketId.

That required a different data source than planned: Coston2's public RPC
rejects eth_getLogs requests with an address filter regardless of block
range (verified empirically). Blockscout's REST API v2 serves the same logs,
pre-decoded against the contract's verified ABI, and works reliably — see
lib/blockscout.ts.

fix: bet encryption now matches the real tee-node's ECIES scheme

frontend/src/lib/ecies.ts previously reproduced eccrypto's format (AES-256-CBC,
SHA-512 KDF) — correct for extension/'s SIMULATED_TEE stub, but incompatible
with the real Go tee-node, which decrypts via go-ethereum's crypto/ecies
(ECIES_AES128_SHA256: AES-128-CTR, NIST concatKDF, HMAC-SHA256 over iv||ciphertext,
wire order ephemPubKey||iv||ciphertext||mac). Confirmed by reading
tee-node@v0.0.23's pkg/utils/crypto.go and go-ethereum@v1.17.4's crypto/ecies
source directly (fce-extension-scaffold's go.sum), then verified with an actual
round-trip: encrypted in JS, decrypted with the real go-ethereum code path,
plaintext matched byte-for-byte.

The old eccrypto-format implementation is kept as eciesEncryptSimulated for
anyone still testing against extension/'s TS stub, just no longer the default.
